# I-21 additive pulses. Do not edit I-18 / I-16 / I-10B / I-14 on_actions.

on_yearly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		sp_i21_yearly_events
	}
}

sp_i21_yearly_events = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:TUR ?= this
				game_date >= 1850.1.1
				NOT = { has_variable = sp_i21_arc_closed }
			}
			set_variable = sp_i21_arc_closed
		}
	}
	events = {
		sp_i21.1
		sp_i21.2
		sp_i21.3
		sp_i21.4
	}
}
